# Non-occupational Labs + RTC orders

Order 4 week follow-up labs + ID Pharmacy RTC order
Additionally, order IF appropriate the following swab(s) 4 week follow-up:
Rectal Chlamydia with Gonorrhea PATIENT OR PROVIDER-COLLECTED Throat Chlamydia with Gonorrhea ONLY PROVIDER COLLECTED Vaginal Chlamydia with Gonorrhea ONLY PROVIDER COLLECTED

## IF above swab ordered place RTC order:

Return to MSP 79 LPN Clinic (Non-occup PEP swabs)
Inpt: ORZID3 GMENU ABX PEP NON-OCCUPATIONAL LABS + RTC
